text:
alex_rahman: Heads-up — planning staggered rewrap next week across AWS KMS + GCP KMS. Need to confirm RBAC, audit hooks, and fallback behavior. TL;DR: canary 5% accounts -> 25% -> 100% over 3 days. Thoughts?

meera.s: +1 on staged. Do we have compatibility for old ciphertext headers? db decrypt path must accept both versions during window.

sam_dev: We do. runtime will accept legacy header v1 and new v2. Need to ensure we don't lose envelope KEKs in cache. Also: gateway must attach key-id metadata.

talia_sec: RBAC checklist: (1) rotation role with kms:ReEncrypt + kms:Decrypt only for rewrap service principal, (2) audit log write-only for rewrap runner, (3) remove ad-hoc key access from prod engineers before rollout. I'll paste a snippet for IAM.

ivan_privacy: Also need to ensure logs are PII redaction — don't log plaintext keys or full ciphertext fields. Audit should contain key-id, principal, object-id, status.

jen_prod: For canary: can we route 5% of requests to a dedicated rewrap worker pool and leave rest untouched? We need metrics: decrypt failure rate, latency delta, cache hit ratio.

opsbot: deploybot: canary cluster rolled to rewrap-runner v2 at 2026-03-25T02:00Z — status: pending.

alex_rahman: Proposed preflight steps: run dry-run rewrap (no write) against a snapshot of 1000 records, verify decrypts, verify application accepts new iv/header, run backward compatibility test for 48 hours.

meera.s: Also prepare a rollback plan: metric thresholds -> abort. Example: decrypt error rate > 0.1% for 15m or latency p50 increase > 150ms for 30m.

sam_dev: Small config note: when rewrapping between KMS providers (AWS->GCP) we will keep data encrypted with envelope key per object referencing provider. Need to ensure lookup order: prefer local provider by owner tag, then global mapping.

talia_sec: Audit hooks: emit event schema like: "event_type": "rewrap", "object_id": "...", "from_key": "...", "to_key": "...", "actor": "...", "status": "success|fail". But redact value fields and send S3 logs + SIEM.

ivan_privacy: Confirm retention policy: audit events kept 7 years? Legal asked for 3 years, security wants longer. We'll record 3 years with ability to export on request.

jen_prod: Operational runbook: step-by-step commands + playbook reference: link (internal) — include emergency revert: stop rewrap, trigger per-object key marker to prefer old key, redeploy decryptors if necessary.

alex_rahman: Any open vuln triage? CVE? We saw a libcrypto update pending — ensure rewrap runner images include latest openssl patch.

meera.s: I can own RBAC changes. I'll open PR to add rewrap-service role, and a separate log-writer role for audit.

sam_dev: I'll add metrics and telemetry. Can we add a "rewrap.failed_objects" counter with tag provider/kek and attach to alert.

talia_sec: I'll prepare post-mortem template and incident contact list. If anything >0.5% failure for 1 hour, page SRE and security.

alex_rahman: OK let's sync in a short meeting tomorrow 09:30 PT. @jen_prod can you draft the canary schedule in runbook? :thumbsup:

jen_prod: On it. I'll post schedule and runbook link by EOD.

opsbot: deploybot: reminder — rotate-runner image build queued.
